items.title: Withdraw from maintenance contract (Widerruf)
items.quote: Sie können diesen Vertrag innerhalb von vierzehn Tagen ohne Begründung widerrufen.
items.computation: The contract was concluded on 20.11.2026 (date the letter was signed and handed over by the technician). The letter states the 14-day withdrawal period begins on the day the contract was concluded, but under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of the event itself is not counted, so counting starts on 21.11.2026. 14 days later is 04.12.2026 (Friday), which is a normal working day in Hamburg, so no shift under § 193 BGB is needed. Sending the withdrawal declaration by this date is sufficient (it need not arrive by then).

items.title: Refund of payments after withdrawal
items.quote: Widerrufen Sie, erstatten wir alle Zahlungen spätestens vierzehn Tage nach Eingang Ihres Widerrufs.
items.computation: This obligation only starts once the customer actually sends a withdrawal declaration; the 14-day refund period then runs from the day the withdrawal is received by the company. Since no withdrawal has been declared yet (and no receipt date is known), the final date cannot be fixed now — it would be 14 days after whichever day the company receives the withdrawal, counted under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB with a § 193 BGB weekend/holiday shift if needed.

warnings: The letter itself only gives a contract term (12 months from 01.01.2027) but states no notice period or deadline for ordinary cancellation at the end of that term, so `cancel_by` could not be determined — check the general terms (AGB) for this.
The refund deadline ('spätestens vierzehn Tage nach Eingang Ihres Widerrufs') is conditional on the customer first sending a withdrawal and cannot be dated until that happens.
